response.html:
Library opening hours

The central library opens from nine in the morning until seven in the evening from Monday to Thursday. On Friday it closes at five, and on Saturday it opens from ten until two.

Study rooms can be booked at the desk for up to two hours. A librarian can help with printing, scanning and the public computers during all opening hours.

gold.why: The original text. One of three copies is used, the rest are repeats.

Library hours, reworded

The central library opens from nine in the morning until seven in the evening, Monday to Thursday. Fridays it closes at five; Saturdays it opens ten to two.

Study rooms can be booked at the front desk for up to two hours. A librarian can help with printing, scanning and the public computers during all opening hours.

About the hours team
